name: The Quartermaster's Furnished Lodge (16-Asset Room-Scale Plan)
description: A 10m x 10m timber-and-stone domestic lodge room containing sixteen metric 3D furniture assets arranged into three functional zones: a northern storage wall, a central dining and dressing parlor, and a southern sleeping alcove. Serves as the canonical room-scale benchmark for top-down orthographic 3D asset projection and Flux 3 Klein diffusion layout control.

zones.name: North Storage & Archive Wall
zones.material: wide oak floorboards along dressed stone masonry
zones.description: Northern wall lined with heavy storage furniture: wardrobe, bookcase, dresser, and cabinet.

zones.name: Central Dining & Dressing Parlor
zones.material: worn timber floorboards with woven runner
zones.description: Central gathering space with table, chair, stool, bench, standing mirror, and folding screen.

zones.name: Southern Sleeping & Wash Alcove
zones.material: pegged pine planking with wool hearth rug
zones.description: Southern quarters containing the bed, cradle, nightstand, sideboard, washstand, and coat-stand.

proscenium_line.description: Primary observer line near the southern threshold looking north across the three zones.
